description: Governed affective TONE of an element or scene — the communicative feeling it should carry. Promoted from the layout engine's Script_Normalizer `emotional_tone` axis (previously an ungoverned inline enum in the sidecar). This is an UPSTREAM signal: set by the generator/normalizer at the intent layer, READ by the realizer to inform expression (skin/style/layout) selection. It is independent of rhetorical intent (what the element does on the page) and pedagogical intent (its job in the learning sequence).

governance.rule: Elements may only use ids defined here. A new value requires a version bump and an entry — the validator rejects anything else. This is the same governance as intent.enum.json and script.primitives.v1.json.
governance.supplants: The inline `emotional_tone` enum in layout-engine intent_sidecar.schema.json (retired in favor of this governed list).

values.label: Neutral
values.definition: Plain, informational register with no particular affective push.

values.label: Confident
values.definition: Assured, authoritative register that lands a point firmly.

values.label: Empathetic
values.definition: Warm, perspective-taking register that acknowledges the learner's situation.

values.label: Reflective
values.definition: Contemplative register that invites the learner to pause and consider.

values.label: Urgent
values.definition: Heightened-stakes register that signals immediacy or risk.
